name: The stairs
prompt: A patient of three hundred pounds, a third-floor walk-up, and a stair chair with a sticking wheel.

choices.text: Call for a lift assist and wait

outcome.told: The fire crew comes in ten minutes and the four of you carry him down. The call runs long.

choices.text: Carry him down with your partner

outcome.told: You make the street with nothing worse than burning arms.

failure.told: Something in your lower back gives on the second landing. You finish the shift on ice.
